fields.label: Job category
fields.note: Rows carry departments[].name (Greenhouse metadata). The page renders 'Job Category' facets from that embedded array; selecting one filters client-side.

fields.label: Office
fields.note: Rows carry offices[].location. The regional routes are the only server-side narrowing: /us, /ap, /hk, /in return the same embedded job array pre-filtered by office country.

notes: The ledger route https://www.imc.com/us/careers/jobs is retired; the live board is https://www.imc.com/<region>/search-careers, whose Next.js RSC payload embeds the full Greenhouse job array (including hidden jobs flagged 'Is Hidden Job?'). The listing route rejects query strings, and the page's 'Job Category' / 'Office' / 'Location' controls operate on that in-page array after hydration, so no filter or keyword is machine-usable via request parameters — everything is applied locally. The only server-side variation is the region path (/eu global, /us, /ap, /hk, /in). Job detail pages embed the employer HTML in the RSC chunk.
evidence: https://www.imc.com/eu/search-careers (200, 722868 bytes: Next.js RSC 'jobs' array with departments/offices; 'Job Category', 'Office' filter labels; rejects query strings)
